name: Homewood Metalworks
old_description: We’re open to the public! Homeowners, Contractors – EVERYONE!
about:
Homewood Metalworks was founded in 1991 in Conway, South Carolina. The company operates its primary manufacturing shop and a 68,000‑square‑foot warehouse in Conway, with additional sales offices in Florence, Moncks Corner, and Laurinburg, North Carolina. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm manufactures custom metal and steel roof and wall panels, structural buildings, and related accessories. It provides a turnkey construction service that includes design of metal buildings to match client floor plans, utility installation, and general contracting. The Conway facility houses an experienced crew and a dedicated fleet of construction vehicles and heavy equipment.

Homewood Metalworks serves homeowners, contractors, and commercial builders across Horry, Florence, Georgetown, Brunswick, Scotland, Robeson, Berkeley, Dorchester, and Charleston counties. Its customer base spans residential, agricultural, and light commercial construction projects.

The company emphasizes its “complete turnkey solution” – from design through installation – backed by over 35 years in the construction trade and an unlimited general contractor license. Its public‑facing sales model allows both contractors and individual property owners to purchase materials directly.
